result.description: A fictional 24-inch creative display designed for illustration, photo retouching, and multitasking in compact workspaces. The Nimble Arc 24 pairs a 1920x1200 IPS panel with a 165Hz refresh rate, 99% sRGB coverage, and a matte anti-glare finish for smooth visuals and consistent color in bright rooms. It includes dual HDMI inputs, one DisplayPort 1.4, and an ergonomic stand with height, tilt, and pivot adjustments. The monitor is intended for everyday office and creator use rather than gaming-first or workstation GPU workflows.
